name: Stone Box
description: Boxes sealed in granite. You cannot tap a stone box at all — you crack it from the outside by picking up the boxes next to it. Three hits and the crust shatters.
howToPlay: Grey stone boxes cannot be tapped while the granite holds. Pick up any box next to one and the stone takes a hit — it jolts, throws dust, and the cracks spread as the colour underneath shows through. After three hits the crust shatters and the box becomes a normal box you can finally tap. One pickup can crack several stone boxes at once.
author: Marble Sorter prototyping
